statement: Projective-space stabilization identifies the exact middle-positivity radical and universal shifted Griffiths injectivity
depends_on: C.1j; projective-bundle formula; cohomological hard Lefschetz
notes: Exact coefficient-one isomorphism for every product polarization; all threefold times odd-dimensional projective space satisfy their own B. The specified quintic products disprove individual-variety implications to Griffiths vanishing or semisimple correspondences. Universal B remains undecided; this is an equivalence rather than main-gate closure.

statement: Abelian projective stabilizations satisfy middle positivity exactly when all nonpositive Beauville pieces of the Griffiths quotient vanish
depends_on: C.1o; Beauville2010 Theorem4.2 and Proposition5.2 pp260-261 and footnote1 p254
notes: The first exact tests are G^2_(0) in dimension4 and G^2_(-1) plus G^2_(0) in dimension5. No ordinary-Chow Beauville vanishing or vanishing of these groups is asserted. Classified conservatively as a proved reformulation.
